facts.statement: The official site posted a video panoramic tour of Sunstone Valley presented by developer Misty Michelle, followed by a second video showing what players can do there.
facts.quote: Faites une visite panoramique de Sunstone Valley

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official freerealms.com news post (titled 'Truc super secret: Vallée des pierres de soleil', i.e. Sunstone Valley) promoting a video tour of Sunstone Valley, described as Free Realms' new adventure zone. It gives no date beyond a relative 'posted 1 month, 2 weeks ago' and no mechanics, quest or reward details.
